q: confessing all their sins, and publishing all the things which they had seen, and explaining the prophecies and the scriptures to all who desired to hear them.

s: sons of Mosiah are instruments of God (bringing many to knowledge of truth)
q: And thus they were instruments in the hands of God in bringing many to the knowledge of the truth, yea, to the knowledge of their Redeemer.

s: sons of Mosiah publish good tidings of good (as blessed messengers)
q: For they did publish peace; they did publish good tidings of good;

s: sons of Mosiah teach the commandments of God (exhorting the church to keep them)
q: confirming their faith, and exhorting them with long-suffering and much travail to keep the commandments of God.

s: king Mosiah prohibits church persecution (throughout the land)
q: And it came to pass that king Mosiah sent a proclamation throughout the land round about that there should not any unbeliever persecute any of those who belonged to the church of God.

s: the commandments of God are to be kept by church of God (with long-suffering and much travail)
q: confirming their faith, and exhorting them with long-suffering and much travail to keep the commandments of God.

s: church persecution is prohibited throughout the land (by proclamation of king Mosiah)
q: And it came to pass that king Mosiah sent a proclamation throughout the land round about that there should not any unbeliever persecute any of those who belonged to the church of God.

s: people practice equality among all men (by strict command)
q: And there was a strict command throughout all the churches that there should be no persecutions among them, that there should be an equality among all men;

s: people esteem neighbor as himself (as part of their conduct)
q: That they should let no pride nor haughtiness disturb their peace; that every man should esteem his neighbor as himself, laboring with their own hands for their support.

s: sons of Mosiah is a sons (of Mosiah)
q: Now it came to pass that after the sons of Mosiah had done all these things, they took a small number with them and returned to their father, the king

s: king Mosiah has no successor to kingdom (none of his sons would accept it)
q: Now king Mosiah had no one to confer the kingdom upon, for there was not any of his sons who would accept of the kingdom

s: king Mosiah translates records (by means of the interpreters)
q: And now he translated them by the means of those two stones which were fastened into the two rims of a bow

s: king Mosiah confers records (upon Alma the younger)
q: he took the plates of brass, and all the things which he had kept, and conferred them upon Alma, who was the son of Alma

s: king Mosiah confers interpreters (upon Alma the younger)
q: yea, all the records, and also the interpreters, and conferred them upon him

s: Lord permits request to preach among the Lamanites (because many shall believe)
q: And the Lord said unto Mosiah: Let them go up, for many shall believe on their words, and they shall have eternal life

s: Lord promises eternal life (to those who believe on their words)
q: for many shall believe on their words, and they shall have eternal life

s: Lord delivers sons of Mosiah (out of the hands of the Lamanites)
q: and I will deliver thy sons out of the hands of the Lamanites

s: land of Nephi is destination of request to preach among the Lamanites (for preaching)
q: that they might, with these whom they had selected, go up to the land of Nephi that they might preach the things which they had heard

s: word of God is imparted to Lamanites (by the sons of Mosiah)
q: they might impart the word of God to their brethren, the Lamanites—

s: records include the plates of brass
q: he took the records which were engraven on the plates of brass

s: sons of Mosiah desire salvation for salvation (for every creature)
q: Now they were desirous that salvation should be declared to every creature, for they could not bear that any human soul should perish

s: records include the plates of Nephi
q: and also the plates of Nephi

s: records include plates of gold (found by the people of Limhi)
q: after having translated and caused to be written the records which were on the plates of gold which had been found by the people of Limhi

s: plates of gold are found by the people of Limhi
q: the records which were on the plates of gold which had been found by the people of Limhi

s: plates of gold are delivered by Limhi (to king Mosiah)
q: which were delivered to him by the hand of Limhi

s: interpreters is a means of interpreting languages (prepared from the beginning)
q: And now he translated them by the means of those two stones which were fastened into the two rims of a bow. 14 Now these things were prepared from the beginning, and were handed down from generation to generation, for the purpose of interpreting languages

s: two stones are fastened into interpreters (the two rims of a bow)
q: those two stones which were fastened into the two rims of a bow

s: interpreters are preserved by Lord (to reveal the iniquities and abominations of his people)
q: And they have been kept and preserved by the hand of the Lord

s: interpreters designate seer (whoever possesses them is called one)
q: And whosoever has these things is called seer, after the manner of old times

s: seer is a possessor of interpreters (after the manner of old times)
q: And whosoever has these things is called seer, after the manner of old times

s: Alma the younger receives records (from king Mosiah)
q: he took the plates of brass, and all the things which he had kept, and conferred them upon Alma, who was the son of Alma; yea, all the records

s: sons of Mosiah preach word of God (among the Lamanites)
q: they might preach the things which they had heard, and that they might impart the word of God to their brethren, the Lamanites—

s: Alma the younger receives interpreters (from king Mosiah)
q: and also the interpreters, and conferred them upon him

s: Alma the younger is commanded to preserve records (from one generation to another)
q: and commanded him that he should keep and preserve them

s: Alma the younger is commanded to record people (handing the record down from one generation to another)
q: and also keep a record of the people, handing them down from one generation to another

s: translation of the records provides account of people who had been destroyed (from their destruction back to the creation of Adam)
q: after Mosiah had finished translating these records, behold, it gave an account of the people who were destroyed

s: people who had been destroyed are traced back to creation of Adam (through the building of the great tower)
q: from the time that they were destroyed back to the building of the great tower, at the time the Lord confounded the language of the people and they were scattered abroad upon the face of all the earth, yea, and even from that time back until the creation of Adam

s: people of Mosiah mourn destruction of the people (exceedingly)
q: Now this account did cause the people of Mosiah to mourn exceedingly

s: sons of Mosiah are vilest of sinners
q: for they were the very vilest of sinners

s: sons of Mosiah suffer anguish because of iniquities (much anguish of soul)
q: nevertheless they suffered much anguish of soul because of their iniquities, suffering much and fearing that they should be cast off forever

s: sons of Mosiah request request to preach among the Lamanites (from king Mosiah)
q: And it came to pass that they did plead with their father many days that they might go up to the land of Nephi

s: king Mosiah is a king
q: And king Mosiah went and inquired of the Lord

s: king Mosiah inquires of Lord (whether to let his sons preach among the Lamanites)
q: And king Mosiah went and inquired of the Lord if he should let his sons go up among the Lamanites to preach the word

s: sons of Mosiah decline kingdom (none were willing to accept it)
q: neither were any of the sons of Mosiah willing to take upon them the kingdom.

s: people are desirous of a king (initially)
q: And it came to pass that the voice of the people came, saying: We are desirous that Aaron thy son should be our king and our ruler.

s: people relinquish king (after being convinced by Mosiah's words)
q: Therefore they relinquished their desires for a king, and became exceedingly anxious that every man should have an equal chance throughout all the land;

s: people choose judges (by their collective voice)
q: Therefore, it came to pass that they assembled themselves together in bodies throughout the land, to cast in their voices concerning who should be their judges, to judge them according to the law which had been given them;

s: people have equal chance (throughout all the land)
q: Therefore they relinquished their desires for a king, and became exceedingly anxious that every man should have an equal chance throughout all the land;

s: king is a ruler (of the people)
q: We are desirous that Aaron thy son should be our king and our ruler.

s: king causes sin (when the king is iniquitous)
q: For behold I say unto you, the sins of many people have been caused by the iniquities of their kings; therefore their iniquities are answered upon the heads of their kings.

s: king can cause destruction (when wicked)
q: For behold, how much iniquity doth one wicked king cause to be committed, yea, and what great destruction!

s: kingdom rightfully belongs to he (will not take upon him the kingdom)
q: Now I declare unto you that he to whom the kingdom doth rightly belong has declined, and will not take upon him the kingdom.

s: Mosiah has age sixty and three years (at death)
q: And it came to pass that Mosiah died also, in the thirty and third year of his reign, being sixty and three years old; making in the whole, five hundred and nine years from the time Lehi left Jerusalem.

s: contentions are a cause of shedding much blood (among the people)
q: which would cause wars and contentions among you, which would be the cause of shedding much blood and perverting the way of the Lord, yea, and destroy the souls of many people.

s: wars are a cause of bloodshed (among the people)
q: which would cause wars and contentions among you, which would be the cause of shedding much blood and perverting the way of the Lord, yea, and destroy the souls of many people.

s: bloodshed is destructive (resulting from wars and contentions)
q: which would cause wars and contentions among you, which would be the cause of shedding much blood and perverting the way of the Lord, yea, and destroy the souls of many people.

s: peace is established by Mosiah (throughout the land)
q: And even I myself have labored with all the power and faculties which I have possessed, to teach you the commandments of God, and to establish peace throughout the land,

s: judges judge people (according to the law)
q: And it came to pass that they did appoint judges to rule over them, or to judge them according to the law; and this they did throughout all the land.

s: judges are chosen by the voice of the people (throughout the land)
q: Therefore, choose you by the voice of this people, judges, that ye may be judged according to the laws which have been given you by our fathers,

s: chief judge is held by Alma (first chief judge)
q: And it came to pass that Alma was appointed to be the first chief judge, he being also the high priest, his father having conferred the office upon him, and having given him the charge concerning all the affairs of the church.

s: laws are given by Lord (through the fathers)
q: Therefore, choose you by the voice of this people, judges, that ye may be judged according to the laws which have been given you by our fathers, which are correct, and which were given them by the hand of the Lord.

s: laws are correct (according to Mosiah's message)
q: the laws which have been given you by our fathers, which are correct, and which were given them by the hand of the Lord.

s: Mosiah establishes peace (throughout the land)
q: And even I myself have labored with all the power and faculties which I have possessed, to teach you the commandments of God, and to establish peace throughout the land, that there should be no wars nor contentions, no stealing, nor plundering, nor murdering, nor any manner of iniquity;

s: the commandments of God are taught by Mosiah (to the people)
q: And even I myself have labored with all the power and faculties which I have possessed, to teach you the commandments of God,

s: God has just judgments (always)
q: Now it is better that a man should be judged of God than of man, for the judgments of God are always just, but the judgments of man are not always just.

s: Lord extends mercy (towards those who put their trust in him)
q: and thus doth the Lord work with his power in all cases among the children of men, extending the arm of mercy towards them that put their trust in him.

s: Alma is a chief judge (first in the land of Zarahemla)
q: And thus commenced the reign of the judges throughout all the land of Zarahemla, among all the people who were called the Nephites; and Alma was the first and chief judge.

s: Alma is a high priest (of the church)
q: And it came to pass that Alma was appointed to be the first chief judge, he being also the high priest, his father having conferred the office upon him, and having given him the charge concerning all the affairs of the church.
